sanskrit_verse: पशुवस्त्रान्नपानानि गृहोपकरणं तथा । हिंसयंश् चौरवद् दाप्यो द्विशतोद्यं दमं तथा ॥
transliteration: paśuvastrānnapānāni gṛhopakaraṇaṃ tathā | hiṃsayaṃś cauravad dāpyo dviśatodyaṃ damaṃ tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who causes harm equivalent to a thief by taking animals, clothing, food, drink, or household items shall be made to pay double the value as restitution, in accordance with the sequential law of completion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious integrity, not institutional force
Causation is determined by direct energetic disruption to another's sustenance capacity
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the degree of access and control exercised
Restoration logic requires proportional recompense to reinstate original support structures
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of shared resource sovereignty
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity takes or damages another’s livestock, garments, food, beverages, or domestic tools THEN that entity MUST repay double the assessed value directly to the affected party.
IF causation is established through sensory evidence AND no counterclaim of existential necessity is validated THEN automatic restitution protocol initiates at 2x assessed market equivalency.
IF the responsible party demonstrates incapacity to pay within 30 days THEN community service aligned with skill capacity shall replace monetary compensation until equivalency is met.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this law applies when material deprivation impacts household stability. The threshold for liability rests on verifiable causation, not intent. Authority lies in restoring balance rather than assigning blame; hence, payment flows unconditionally upon proof of loss.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes factual causality via witness, record, or consequence mapping. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures repayment occurs prior to societal reintegration. Proportional responsibility reflects doubling not as penalty but correction. Non-punitive reality is upheld since suffering is absent—only completion of energetic debt remains.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset assessment and immediate notification of obligation to restore
Assign facilitator to ensure transaction between parties within seven days
Verify completion through receipt acknowledgment and energetic resonance scan
If default occurs, activate alternative fulfillment pathway based on individual dharma-skandha
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. This Dharma restores balance without infliction. Reality operates beyond punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
